name: Illusory Retreat (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 8

Benefit: Whenever the saboteur takes the withdraw action, she turns invisible and leaves an illusory duplicate in her place, as the spell mislead. However, the invisibility provided only lasts 1 round, and the major image created cannot be concentrated on. The save DC is equal to her trick DC, as opposed to the normal DC of mislead.
